_about: Requests that are PairFree's own ideas, not something the vendor's app has (so not part of the release gate): a user asks, the owner decides. Move an entry to data/completeness.json when it turns out to be a gap against the vendor's app.

items.what: Connection mode and spatial audio among the home screen widget's choices (a widget slot that sets a brand's toggle or choice row).
One more action (game mode) in the status notification.
Remember the connection mode and set it again each time the earbuds connect.
Noise control reverted to off at the first connection, then worked (one report, not reproduced).

Run on Android 11 (minSdk is 31): the Bluetooth permission model, dynamic colour and the notification code have Android 12 paths; a Redmi Note 10T on Android 11 cannot install it (F-Droid: not compatible; the APK: problem parsing the package). The owner decides whether it is worth the compatibility code.

Altec Lansing Bluetooth speakers (HydraMini to SoundRover, 17 models, a BLE service with a write and a notify characteristic, lighting colours and battery): a new vendor and speakers, which are held back. The only source so far is a third party's notes on the app; the Altec Lansing app itself is not among the reference APKs, so nothing can be built from it yet.

Motorola Moto Buds (companion app com.motorola.motobuds): a new vendor. The issue holds a long protocol write-up from a user's reading of the app (RFCOMM service fc9d9fe0-4899-11ee-be56-0242ac120002 and BLE service fc9d9ff0-..., a PDU with a HEAD magic, CRC32 and an opcode registry); none of it is checked against the app or earbuds yet, and no Motorola APK is among the reference APKs.
